title: Contract criteria cover behavior, docs, and code quality

criteria.statement: The ingestion endpoint forwards a valid record without changing its fields.
criteria.hollow_delivery: The endpoint accepts the request but silently drops or rewrites a field.

check.procedure: Submit a valid record to the ingestion endpoint and read the forwarded record.
check.observable: The forwarded record equals the submitted record field for field.
check.conforming_case: A valid record is forwarded with every field unchanged.
check.falsifying_case: A valid record is forwarded with a field dropped or rewritten.

criteria.acceptance_criterion: An API consumer submits a valid record and handles each validation failure from the reference alone
criteria.statement: An API consumer, reading only the API reference, constructs a valid record submission and recovers from each documented validation failure without reading source.
criteria.hollow_delivery: The reference is touched but an API consumer still cannot construct a submission or handle a failure from it alone — or no reference change lands at all.

check.actor: cold recipient (API consumer) equipped only with the API reference
check.procedure: Construct the primary record submission and perform one documented validation-failure recovery following the reference alone.
check.observable: The submission is accepted and the recovery clears the failure without reading source.
check.conforming_case: The reference-built submission passes and the documented recovery clears the invalid-field failure.
check.falsifying_case: The consumer must read handler source to construct the submission or clear the failure.

criteria.acceptance_criterion: The reference's failure taxonomy generalizes: a reader classifies a novel validation failure from the taxonomy alone
criteria.statement: The API reference's validation-failure taxonomy transmits: a cold reader classifies a failure response absent from its worked examples into the documented classes and names the documented recovery.
criteria.hollow_delivery: The taxonomy section lists the worked examples verbatim; a reader can replay them but misroutes any failure the examples do not spell out.

check.actor: instantiated cold recipient (fresh reader, reference-only context)
check.procedure: Present a validation-failure response absent from the reference's examples; the recipient classifies it into the documented taxonomy and names the recovery, graded against the stated proposition.
check.observable: Classification and recovery match the taxonomy — pass; a guess outside it — fail.
check.conforming_case: A novel missing-field failure is classified under the documented required-field class with its documented recovery.
check.falsifying_case: The recipient replays a worked example and misclassifies the novel failure.

criteria.statement: Record validation continues through the shared validator path.
criteria.hollow_delivery: A second validator is added for this endpoint only.

check.procedure: Run the fitness test asserting exactly one module imports the shared validator.
check.observable: The run reports exactly one importer of the shared validator.
check.conforming_case: One importer: the ingestion handler routes through the shared validator.
check.falsifying_case: A second, endpoint-local validator imports or reimplements validation.
